name: matrixValid
meaning: bit 0: the parent published this link's matrix during its Render (AttachLinkFlags 1) | AttachLink.flags as one-bit u8 fields; every access is a byte bitfield access (Scn_RenderIfVisible: mov cl,[x+7]; shr cl,1; and cl,1; xor edx,edx; mov dl,cl)

name: parentDone
meaning: bit 1: the parent has been through Scn_RenderIfVisible this frame (set on every child link at 0x56015d)

name: rootRotation
meaning: bit 2: AttachLink_Alloc's rootRotation argument; Instance_CalcWorldMatrix then keeps the child's own rotation

name: hasLocal
meaning: bit 3: localOffset is applied (in the parent part's frame, *8)

name: hasWorld
meaning: bit 5: worldOffset is added to the child's translation (*8)
